method: Government open-data catalogue resolution followed by checksum-pinned acquisition from official publisher endpoints; no researcher mirror used
correction: The first conclusion that the Ausgrid dataset was unavailable was wrong. It checked the publishing body's current listing and an obsolete binary URL, but omitted the surviving Data.NSW government open-data record. Agencies move files and catalogue records can outlive publisher paths.

resolved_sources.result: Exact official-origin Ausgrid archive recovered through the Internet Archive after the Data.NSW record established provenance. It contains the 2012-13 CSV and Ausgrid's data notes.
Twelve official monthly archives, August 2025 through July 2026, acquired and pinned; 17,520 half-hour observations for each of NSW1 and VIC1.
Twelve official monthly HTML products each for Sydney IDCJDW2124 and Melbourne IDCJDW3033 acquired and pinned; 363 and 364 complete min/max-temperature days respectively.

outcome: Source gate resolved. The obsolete URLs remain recorded as failed provenance evidence; the Phase 3 build uses only pinned official/government-catalogued sources and keeps all raw bytes outside Git.
